title: Friday (28) for presidential candidates: interviews, debates, and rallies
seoTitle: Friday for presidential candidates: debates and rallies
subtitle: Presidential candidates held interviews, debates, rallies, and other campaign events in various cities
excerpt: On Friday (28), the presidential candidates' schedule featured interviews, debates, rallies, and campaign events across different locations.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Friday (28) brought an intense schedule for the presidential candidates. The candidates' agenda included interviews, debate sessions, rallies, and other campaign actions carried out in different cities across the country.

Diverse Schedule

The candidates divided their time between debate activities, which allow for the exchange of ideas and the presentation of proposals, and interviews—more informal meetings that foster direct contact with voters. In addition, rallies and other campaign events were organized, expanding the presence of the presidential candidates in various locations.

Presence in Multiple Cities

The activities took place in different cities, demonstrating the candidates' effort to reach voters in various regions. Each action—whether an interview, a debate, or a rally—is part of the presidential candidates' campaign strategy, as they seek to increase their visibility and dialogue with the public.

With information from Agência Brasil.
